title: Book VII
coreMove: Keep principles alive by renewing the matching thought at the moment pressure returns.
sourcePressure: Dense maxims reanimate principles against familiar badness, future fear, pain, fame, death, first appearances, and unused social help.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: memorize maxims and assume remembering equals living

sourceAnchors.name: badness is familiar
sourceAnchors.detail: Book VII opens by saying badness is familiar, nothing is new, and principles die only if matching thoughts go out.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The point of familiar badness is not boredom; it is refusing to be morally dazzled by repetition.

sourceAnchors.name: one law and one common reason
sourceAnchors.detail: Book VII strengthens social logic through one law, one common reason, and membership in rational life.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A living principle has to find the common reason again while pressure is still warm.

counterintuition: what looks like control is actually surrender
the real problem is not outside you
tryThisNow: write down what you can control
examples: generic office meeting with laptop and coffee
parent-child bedtime conflict repeated across chapters

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective recognition, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.audience: Olivia facing the same commuter shove every Monday
exampleSpecs.stakes: familiar rudeness keeps feeling like a fresh moral emergency
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Olivia notices the shove, names it as old material, and steps aside without constructing a whole grievance.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The platform loudspeaker crackles before the crowd surges.

exampleSpecs.audience: Etienne seeing the same flashy proposal bias
exampleSpecs.stakes: the panel keeps forgetting its own criteria
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Etienne reads the criteria aloud before anyone discusses reputation or charisma.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: "Before we admire the pitch, let us read the rubric."

exampleSpecs.stakes: her principle of fairness weakens under the room's impatience
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Maja resets the score sheet after the cracked first note and listens through the full excerpt.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Rosin dust shines on the edge of the audition table.

exampleSpecs.audience: Chris finding another tenant dispute over noise
exampleSpecs.stakes: future dread wants to rehearse the whole argument before it begins
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: You watch Chris write only the observed decibel reading before calling either tenant.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You hear the bass through the hallway before you hear either story.

exampleSpecs.audience: Nina reading a hostile reviewer note
exampleSpecs.stakes: the first sting could become a day of imagined contempt
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: It took Nina one paragraph to see she was answering a tone instead of the methodological point.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: It took Nina one paragraph to notice the heat in her face.

exampleSpecs.stakes: crowd anger tries to replace the actual rule
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: What remains after the noise leaves the clip?
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Tomas pauses the video at the contact point and grades only position, timing, and law.

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'

skillTargets: apply present reason to future fear
separate first appearance from added judgment

tryThisNowSpec: When an old irritation returns, state the principle it usually makes you forget, then act from that sentence once.
